added_lines: A proud milestone for the Keysight India Quality Team. Project ONE earned the Platinum Award and first runner-up recognition in the Design for Six Sigma category at the CII Six Sigma Case Study Contest 2026, standing out among 110 project entries. The project transformed ITAR training compliance tracking through a centralized, automated Smartsheet solution designed to strengthen compliance monitoring, audit readiness, transparency, and stakeholder experience.
Congratulations to the Keysight India Quality Team on this recognition for innovation, technical excellence, and execution!
